native_mechanisms: One fold per mark, each fold's angle determined jointly by the mark and the immediately preceding crease, so state carries forward.
Gauge every crease against all four wire birds' beaks simultaneously and refold tighter until all four agree, deliberately mis-aligning the spiral/snail markings so distinct piles can't coincide.
Thin the whole folded wad at the water's edge into one tiny dense corner (the token) and destroy every scrap, trimmed sheet and failed gauge reading.
core_technique: xxHash64 verbatim: four independent 64-bit striped accumulator lanes running the standard add-multiply-rotl-multiply round over 32-byte blocks, merged by rotl(1,7,12,18) plus mergeRound, length added, 8/4/1-byte tail folds, then a murmur-style xor-shift/multiply avalanche finalizer — i.e. the known multiply-xor-rotate accumulator fold, with the four 'birds' reduced to lane seeds/constants and no consensus test or refold-until-agreement anywhere.
